name: HTTP connection on form submit
expected: The HTTP connection runs for the saved record, uses the field values in the placeholders and saves the response values.

name: SOAP/WSDL connection on form submit
expected: The SOAP/WSDL connection runs for the saved record, uses the parameter values and saves the response values.

name: Trigger on schedule
expected: A connection which is configured to trigger on schedule is correctly triggered at the scheduled time.
